use_limit: This matrix describes evidence that a future implementation candidate would have to supply. It selects no component, path, dependency, key, store, runner, private data, runtime, output, or GO.

gate_catalog.requirement: Component inputs and outputs preserve the accepted object's exact field order, types, domains, nullability, and additional-key refusal.
Every source path, dependency, package, configuration, key, and profile has an exact independently rehashed identity.
Every hash, KDF, signature, proof, counter, selector, and branch has one literal domain-separated preimage or checked derivation.
Every physical equality endpoint and typed instance alias resolves exactly with no generic, pseudo, caller-chosen, or future selector.
Hash, equality, selector, condition, and authentication-stage dependencies produce one complete acyclic graph with no same-or-later reads.
Genesis, positive recurrence, replay rejection, no-fork CAS, immediate predecessor, and uint64 overflow behavior are tested.
Success, technical failure, refusal, withholding, invalid reveal, disconnect, restart, and rollback cannot leave a held or ambiguous state.
Private material remains hidden; public evidence exposes only the accepted statement, derivation relation, and authorized retained fields.
Erase/retain boundaries, crash recovery, restart reconstruction, rollback, migration, backup, and actual-storage behavior have explicit receipts.
A separately implemented hostile suite rejects malformed, stale, sibling, transplanted, replayed, reordered, omitted, duplicated, and caller-selected variants with zero false accepts.
Logs, exceptions, metrics, caches, temporary files, backups, evidence, and diagnostics are tested for private-content leakage and retention drift.

Any future candidate receives a fresh immutable identity and genuinely independent audit; passing tests never imply consciousness, personhood, live memory, actual forgetting, production integration, or GO.
